pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-01-16. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-01-16 at 1,834.83 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 7.97 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 1,213 million. The top gainer of the week was Bahari Holdings (SYN).

Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
